in_sanskrit.name: ध्यान
in_sanskrit.meaning: ध्यानम् (dhYAnam) - meditation, contemplation, or deep thought
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: ध्यानम् (dhYAnam) - the act of focusing one's mind on a particular object, thought, or activity to achieve a deeper understanding or realization. It is a practice that involves concentration and mindfulness.

in_marathi.name: Dhyan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Meditation, Contemplation, Reflection
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhyan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhyan refers to the practice of deep concentration and meditation in Hinduism. It signifies the act of focusing the mind on a single point, often a deity or mantra, to achieve inner peace and self-realization.
